prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home, neighborhood, price range, and how much hands-on support you want. Based on the available local results, **Tim McGuire of Compass** looks like a strong candidate to interview: his profile shows substantial Pleasanton activity, many reviews, and recent seller feedback mentioning preparation, staging, marketing, and local knowledge.

I’d also compare him with **Doug Buenz**, who has recent Pleasanton seller reviews describing hands-on help with pre-sale updates, and **Varsha Upadhye**, who ranks highly in one agent directory’s transaction-based Pleasanton rankings. Those rankings and review sites use different methods, so treat them as leads—not a definitive verdict.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents and ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side** sales in your neighborhood and price range
- Their recommended list price, with comparable sales to support it
- A written marketing and preparation plan
- Who will handle showings, negotiations, and day-to-day communication
- Their commission and any other fees, in writing

The best fit is the agent who can clearly justify a pricing strategy and show relevant recent results—not simply the one with the biggest sales total.
